item.title: Newton Girls Season Ends With Loss To Carlisle
item.description: The Newton Girls Basketball Squad fell to Carlisle on Saturday in the class 4A Regional semifinals 47-18. It was all Wildcats from the start jumping out to a 13-2 first quarter lead, causing 15 1st half turnovers.

item.title: Norwalk Girls Basketball Holds Off Lewis Central in Substate Semifinals
item.description: (Photo courtesy of Bakerink Visuals) The Norwalk girls basketball team earned a spot in the Class 4A regional finals with a win over Lewis Central in Saturday’s regional semifinal, which was heard live on the KNIA3 stream.

item.title: Pella Girls Basketball Team Hangs On in Regional Semifinals Against Ballard
item.description: An early charge to a 17-point advantage turned into a closer 4th quarter as the Pella girls basketball team knocked off Ballard 43-33 in a Class 4A Regional Semifinals game heard live on 92.1 KRLS on Saturday.
